description: Source code for WidgetPreviewActivity, an Android activity that allows users to select, configure, preview, and save widget snapshots, as well as share them via email.

classes.name: WidgetPreviewActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages widget selection, configuration, preview rendering, snapshot saving, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and manages widget binding or selection.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains widget info across configuration changes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from widget selection and configuration activities.

methods.name: setAppWidget
methods.description: Sets up the widget view after selection or configuration.

methods.name: finishSetAppWidget
methods.description: Finalizes widget setup and prepares preview.

methods.name: getLauncherCellDimensions
methods.description: Calculates widget preview dimensions based on cell size and device orientation.

methods.name: buildFile
methods.description: Creates a file path for saving widget snapshot images based on device orientation.

methods.name: getPreviewBitmap
methods.description: Captures a bitmap snapshot of the widget view.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the widget snapshot bitmap to external storage.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back button presses to either pop back stack or start widget selection.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks for snapshot saving and email sharing.
